name: Coordinate Transformations
definition: Deterministic functions $\boldsymbol{\gamma}_i : \mathbb{R}^D \rightarrow \mathbb{R}^{F_i}$ that transform input coordinates before being passed to factor fields.
summary: Coordinate transformations map input spatial coordinates to a transformed domain for factor fields, serving as a pre-processing step that handles internal neural representation mapping rather than camera-to-world projection.
